CVE-2017-18342.title: CVE-2017-18342: PyYAML Default load Resolves Arbitrary Tags
CVE-2017-18342.description: CVE-2017-18342 PyYAML yaml.load resolved arbitrary Python tags by default. Replace it with safe_load and pin PyYAML 6.0 or later where practical.

CVE-2021-41773.title: CVE-2021-41773: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 Path Traversal
CVE-2021-41773.description: CVE-2021-41773 Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 path traversal can expose files and enable CGI RCE. Upgrade to 2.4.51+; the 2.4.50 fix is incomplete.

CVE-2021-42013.title: CVE-2021-42013: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 Incomplete-Fix Bypass
CVE-2021-42013.description: CVE-2021-42013 is the Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 incomplete-fix bypass for CVE-2021-41773. Upgrade 2.4.49/2.4.50 to 2.4.51+ to stop traversal and CGI RCE.

CVE-2021-35395.title: CVE-2021-35395: Realtek AP-Router SDK Buffer Overflow
CVE-2021-35395.description: CVE-2021-35395 affects Realtek AP-Router SDK boa web servers. Apply Realtek's listed boa patch for SDK 3.2.3, 3.4.11, 3.4T-CT, or rtl819x-eCos 1.5.3.

CVE-2024-23897.title: CVE-2024-23897: Jenkins CLI Arbitrary File Read
CVE-2024-23897.description: CVE-2024-23897 allows arbitrary Jenkins controller files to be read via CLI. Upgrade every affected software branch to 2.442, LTS 2.426.3, or LTS 2.440.1.

CVE-2024-37079.title: CVE-2024-37079: VMware vCenter Out-of-Bounds Write RCE
CVE-2024-37079.description: CVE-2024-37079 is a critical vCenter Server out-of-bounds-write RCE. Upgrade to 8.0 U2d, 8.0 U1e, or 7.0 U3r; Broadcom lists no workaround.

CVE-2024-47575.title: CVE-2024-47575: FortiManager Authentication Bypass
CVE-2024-47575.description: CVE-2024-47575 is the exploited FortiManager authentication bypass. Upgrade to 6.2.13, 6.4.15, 7.0.13, 7.2.8, 7.4.5, or 7.6.1.

CVE-2025-20281.title: CVE-2025-20281: Cisco ISE API Root RCE (CSCwo99449)
CVE-2025-20281.description: CVE-2025-20281 Cisco ISE/ISE-PIC API root RCE (CSCwo99449). Upgrade 3.3 to Patch 7 and 3.4 to Patch 2; attempted exploitation is reported.

CVE-2025-20337.title: CVE-2025-20337: Cisco ISE API Root RCE (CSCwp02814)
CVE-2025-20337.description: CVE-2025-20337 Cisco ISE/ISE-PIC API root RCE (CSCwp02814). CSCwo99449 hot patches do not fix it; upgrade to 3.3 Patch 7 or 3.4 Patch 2.

CVE-2025-64446.title: CVE-2025-64446: FortiWeb Path Traversal Command Execution
CVE-2025-64446.description: CVE-2025-64446 is known-exploited FortiWeb path traversal enabling admin commands. Upgrade every affected software branch: 8.0.2, 7.6.5, 7.4.10, 7.2.12, or 7.0.12.

CVE-2026-1731.title: CVE-2026-1731: BeyondTrust RS and PRA Pre-Auth RCE
CVE-2026-1731.description: CVE-2026-1731 is an exploited pre-auth RCE in BeyondTrust RS and PRA. Upgrade RS to 25.3.2+ and PRA to 25.1.1+, or apply the BT26-02 appliance patch.

CVE-2026-20045.title: CVE-2026-20045: Cisco Unified Communications Pre-Auth RCE
CVE-2026-20045.description: CVE-2026-20045 is a pre-auth RCE in Cisco Unified Communications products. Upgrade 14.x to 14SU5 and 15.x to 15SU4; migrate 12.5 because no workaround exists.

CVE-2026-20182.title: CVE-2026-20182: Cisco SD-WAN Authentication Bypass
CVE-2026-20182.description: CVE-2026-20182 is an exploited Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN authentication bypass. Upgrade each component to the fixed release for its branch; no workaround exists.

CVE-2026-33116.title: CVE-2026-33116: .NET System.Security.Cryptography.Xml DoS
CVE-2026-33116.description: CVE-2026-33116 affects System.Security.Cryptography.Xml with denial-of-service flaws. Upgrade each deployed .NET 8, 9, or 10 release train to a patched build.
